Seamless 360 degree cylindrical panorama strip, a skybox backdrop for a stylised video game with the stylised realism of a modern Nintendo golf game: believable light and atmosphere, bold saturated colour, slightly painterly. A perfectly straight level horizon line runs across the whole image at one fifth of the height from the bottom edge. Below the horizon only a snowfield and frozen valley in blue shadow. Above it a crisp cold alpine day: deep cobalt sky, a few thin cirrus streaks, a small brilliant sun in the left third about one third of the way up the sky. All the way round the horizon stands an unbroken wall of enormous jagged snow-covered peaks and glaciers, sunlit on one side with blue shadows on the other, reaching up to a quarter of the image height, with lower dark pine-forested ridges in pale haze at their feet. No foreground objects, no people, no animals, no text, no logos, no real landmarks, no lens flare streaks, no vignette, no frame. The left edge and the right edge match exactly so the strip wraps around seamlessly.
